title: A physics of every thing that can be told apart

statements.text: The principle applies to any thing that can be distinguished statistically from other things, and the resulting Bayesian mechanics is compatible with quantum, statistical and classical mechanics.

sources.quote: This monograph attempts a theory of every 'thing' that can be distinguished from other things in a statistical sense.
The ensuing Bayesian mechanics is compatible with quantum, statistical and classical mechanics and may offer a formal description of lifelike particles.
